blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Around 100 koi were released into Burnham Lake recently as part of the city’s efforts to control algae growth and improve water quality. According to the Baguio City Public Information Office on Friday (Oct. 30), local volunteer and recreational development consultant Rafael Serrano and Baguio City Jail Male Dormitory warden Atty. Dexter Ngipol led the release. The consultant said the action was approved by Mayor Benjamin Magalong and City Environment and Parks Management Office (CEPMO) head Atty. Rhenan Diwas.
